message: The template call '{0}' cannot be part of another expression or statement. A template can only be called as a stand-alone statement.
rationale: The message is a comma splice and lacks an article before 'Template call'; 'it can only be done' is vague. The meaning matches TemplateAnnotator.VisitInvocationExpression (line 1106), which reports when the parent of the invocation is not an ExpressionStatementSyntax.
codeChange: For a conditional access such as 'templates?.CalledTemplate()', the placeholder is the text of the inner invocation, '.CalledTemplate()' (see the Subtemplates/Conditional test). Pass the text of the enclosing ConditionalAccessExpressionSyntax instead.
